_README: Applied by compile_sources.py after merging the research files, so these fixes survive a regeneration. Validation 2026-10-20: all 576 sources compiled from passes A-I; each of the 464 PMIDs was fetched from PubMed esummary, each of the 469 DOIs from Crossref (465 found; the 4 others resolve at doi.org), and PMC IDs from Europe PMC, then author, title, journal, year, volume, issue and pages were compared field by field (compare.py, strict.py). 14 entries were flagged; all but the ones below were group-author names, Supplement volumes, 19th-century papers without volume, or in-press 2026 papers without a volume yet. Non-journal sources (FDA and EMA labels, registries, guideline and charity pages) were opened by the passes on 2026-10-20 and carry their URL.

Masaoka1981.note: The DOI of this 1981 paper contains a semicolon (…3.0.co;2-r), which cut the generated link short; the link now goes to the PubMed record.

Mittag1980.note: Crossref lists different metadata for this DOI; PubMed (PMID 7360170) and doi.org both give this NEJM letter, so the entry follows PubMed.
